_doc: Fragment 'impacts' (prefix im.): riser -> stop-down hole -> impact at 24.0 s and 56.0 s, and the 112.5 s sting. Every sound is a trimmed real Mixkit recording (review/audio-sourcing.md); nothing is synthesized.
_holes: The stop-down hole is f 712.5-720 and f 1672.5-1680 (cues kind 'stopdown', 0.25 s). riser.end sits on the impact frame, so the riser rule offsets -0.25 s: the riser ends where the hole opens and nothing sounds inside the hole until the impact attack. Kind 'veil' (act02:veil:1) has no rule on purpose.

im.riser._about: Mixkit 790 'Cinematic trailer riser' (primary, 2.575 s, real 0.92). Level rises to the very last sample (peak 2.53 s), so the file is used whole and chokes into the hole on a 25 ms fade.

im.riser.whip._about: Mixkit 1516 'Magic whip swell' (alternate, real 0.98): the rising first 1.5 s only, layered under the riser for body in its last 1.5 s. Peak 1.26 s, still -5 dB at 1.5 s, so it chokes with the riser.
im.riser.whip.qa_ok: deliberate: choked into the stop-down hole with the riser (its source continues after 1.5 s)

im.hit._about: Mixkit 2908 'Movie trailer epic impact' (primary, real 0.90; 20-80 Hz is its loudest band). The file opens with a swell, the hit lands at 0.91 s; used from 0.90 s (earshot match on that trim z +3.3). Ends at 2.95 s: the source is digital silence after 3.0 s.

im.hit.sub._about: Mixkit 564 'Soft horror hit drum' (bass drum primary, real 0.79, peak 36 ms), low-passed to the sub as a layer on the frame: Iowa MIS has no bass drum.

im.sting.hit._about: The same bass drum 564 as a SOFT impact for the sting: low-passed to 300 Hz, cut at 1.2 s with a 0.5 s fade so it never covers the tonal tail the score carries.

im.sting.shimmer._about: Mixkit 3062 'Magic wand sparkle' (primary, real 0.96, 2.5 s, attack 68 ms, centroid 8-9 kHz). Fade 0.9 s so it is gone before the tail ends; shelved a little so it does not get harsh against the score.

im.swell._about: Mixkit 169 'Futuristic sweep pass by' (primary for a rising swoosh, real 0.85; centroid 3.8 -> 5.9 kHz, level peak at 0.78 s). Used 0.28-1.25 s: the rise into the peak, then a 0.3 s fade of its tail so it does not cover the sting.

rules.qa_ok: deliberate: the riser is choked into the stop-down hole, 0.25 s before the impact, on a 25 ms fade
